objects.description: [Storm-1811](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1046) XOR encodes a [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154) installation payload in a DLL file that is decoded with a hardcoded key when called by a legitimate 7zip installation process.(Citation: rapid7-email-bombing)
